title: init writes a config that doctor then warns about
desc:
wb init --write in a fresh repo writes .workflow/config.json and nothing else; the very next wb doctor warns: .workflow/ is not ignored; artifacts will show up in every diff, with the lines to add. init proposes and doctor disposes of the same repo, so the fix doctor prints belongs in the proposal.

ACCEPTANCE:
- wb init lists the .gitignore lines it would add when .workflow/ is not ignored
- wb init --write appends them (never rewriting existing lines), and says so
- an already-correct .gitignore is left untouched
- doctor passes the gitignore check right after init --write
- tests for missing, partial and correct .gitignore
